evidence: Build/static/host contracts only; no Windows 98 guest result for this provider or for its routing policy
limits: GetTickCount64 cannot recover wraps before DLL load or multiple unobserved wraps
SRW contention uses Sleep(1); no fairness guarantee
GetProcAddress only redirects implemented names for the real KERNEL32 handle through prepared calls
InitOnce has no abandoned-thread or SEH recovery; exact native error parity remains unverified
UTF conversion is independently implemented for CP_UTF8; other code pages delegate to native KERNEL32
UTF maximal-subpart replacement, strict alignment, full-range overlap rejection and error precedence have no native Windows differential proof
AddVectoredExceptionHandler order is host-tested; it is not connected to a CPU trap or the Win98 SEH chain
RemoveVectoredExceptionHandler returns 0 for an unknown handle and does not pretend success
Routing: only KERNEL32.DLL names are routed; other modules and ordinal imports pass through in every mode
Routing: a KernelEx-supplied pointer is recognised only when it lies inside a KernelEx API library that GetModuleHandleA can see in this process; otherwise it counts as native
Routing: static exports already bound to NTW32.DLL forward to native or KernelEx when the policy selects them; when nothing else exists the own implementation stays bound
Routing: the KernelEx module names and the probing behaviour are host-tested against mocks only; no KernelEx installation was observed here
